name: EDS GeX gravel electronic
use_case: Fully wireless 1x gravel with 46T or 52T rear range
positioning: The Chinese wide-range wireless option: choose derailleur cage and hanger configuration before treating it as one product.
architecture: Fully wireless control with an integrated rechargeable rear-derailleur battery and wireless levers.

weight.note: Do not carry the older 7-13-speed RA-package 1.14 kg figure into the current 3-14-speed revision without an exact package match.

battery: Rear derailleur 800 mAh; current materials describe about 20,000 shifts and 800 charge cycles.
controls_and_app: App speed selection and fine adjustment plus ANT+ support.
package_summary: Current packages combine rear derailleur, two levers, hydraulic calipers/hoses and charging cable; confirm 75/93 mm cage, lever material and standard-hanger or UDH-specific configuration.

compatibility.freehub: Depends on the selected 3-14-speed cassette; verify cassette, chain and wheel together
compatibility.hanger: Standard-hanger and UDH-specific configurations exist; order the exact one
compatibility.frame: No internal electronic wire route; verify cage clearance and selected hanger version

china_price_status: No attributable exact mainland GeX package price captured in this batch.
caveats: Keep the current 3-14-speed revision separate from older 7-13-speed RA records.
A 75 mm 46T unit and 93 mm 52T unit are not interchangeable specifications.
Confirm cassette indexing, chain, hanger configuration, lever material and warranty route.
